S1.title: MultiScape50 CubeSat camera: 8-band VNIR Earth observation

S2.title: xScape50 CubeSat Optical Payload — 1U | Simera Sense

notes: Full field of view 13.68° (across-track); digital TDI 1 to 32 stages set individually per band; optional CCSDS 122.0-B-2 lossy/lossless compression; radiation 'Fully functional to 15 kRad'. f-number not published. Maker calls it 1U, but the listed 120.5 mm dimension is longer than a 100 mm unit, so check it against the bus payload bay. Downloads listed on the page (xScape50 ICD, User Manual, 'xScape50 Imager Envelope', brochure) sit behind an on-page panel whose access terms and file formats could not be seen; documentation also 'by request'. The xScape50 range FAQ says the three xScape50 variants (TriScape50 RGB/video, MultiScape50, HyperScape50) share 'the same mechanical and electrical interface' (S2).

S2.title: xScape100 CubeSat camera - RGB, multi- and hyperspectral

notes: Full field of view 2.22° (across-track); digital TDI 1 to 32 stages set individually per band; optional CCSDS 122.0-B-2 lossy/lossless compression; radiation 'Fully functional to 15 kRad'. f-number not published. Although the volume is 1.5U, the maker positions the xScape100 range for 6U and larger platforms (S2); the 176.5 mm length should be checked against the bus payload bay. The xScape100 FAQ says TriScape100, MultiScape100 and HyperScape100 'share the same 1.5U size, 4.75 m GSD, and 19.4 km swath' (S2). Downloads listed on S1 (xScape100 ICD, User Manual, 'xScape100 Imager Envelope', brochure) sit behind an on-page panel whose access terms and file formats could not be seen; documentation also 'by request'. Sometimes listed by third parties as 'MultiScape100 CIS'.

S2.title: xScape200 Dual-Use - Sub-2 m EO camera for CubeSats

notes: High-resolution option that needs more than a 12U bus: the instrument volume is 12U but the maker states it is 'designed to be able to fly in a 16U or larger satellite bus' (S2). Dual-use product aimed at commercial, government and defence operators; maker FAQ: 'No, the imager is not ITAR restricted' (S2) - confirm export licensing for your case. Radiation 25 kRad (tested total dose). Page also gives 'Effective field of view 0.44° (along-track)'. f-number, SNR and band wavelengths not published. Downloads listed include 'xScape200 Dual-Use ICD (Draft)' and 'xScape200 Dual-Use Imager Envelope' behind an on-page panel; documentation also by request. URL /products/multiscape200/ serves the same page.

Narrow operating range +10 °C to +30 °C (survival -20 °C to +55 °C), so it needs thermal control; the maker's CubeSat-cameras overview page instead quotes 'operating temperature range -20 +70 C' for the family (S2), which conflicts with the product page. TRL 9. Optics, detector and pixel size not published. Brochure only via corporate e-mail form; no CAD, price or lead time published.

Older (2019) Chameleon brochures hosted on a reseller site predate the current product page and were not used. Brochure only via corporate e-mail form; no CAD, price or lead time published.

notes: High-resolution option for 12U/16U buses. Very little is published officially: only mass, GSD, swath and heritage ('validated in Space in Q4 2021'). Swath at 500 km is 'PAN & VNIR: 13 - 23,5 km' and 'SWIR: 8,2 km' (the value field holds the lower PAN/VNIR figure); GSD at 500 km is PAN & VNIR 2 m, SWIR 5 m. Power, volume, interfaces, temperature range, optics, detector and storage must be obtained from SATLANTIS. Third-party catalogues quote conflicting masses and single/dual-channel versions; those were not used.
